Name: (AT) ErikaCAT's More Jukeboxes
Author: ErikaCAT
Description:
This mod includes 5 retextures of the mini jukebox (I might make more) so you can have a mini jukebox that just looks better, because I don't know about you but I think it looks pretty bad compared to the rest of my house and I think we all need some more options for the jukebox. 


How to install and use:

1. Download the file and Alternative Textures
2. Extract the files and put in the mods folder for Stardew Valley
3. Start the game and go to Robin's shop to buy the Paint Bucket
4. Use the Paint Bucket on the mini jukebox and select which texture you want for the jukebox
5. Enjoy your new and improved jukebox
